title: A leakage reviewer that reads the prediction moment
request: Add a leakage reviewer to the wizard and the intern: it reads the prediction moment, the column names with their kinds and summaries, and the column audit's flags, and proposes which columns are unavailable at that moment, each with a reason that quotes the moment and evidence records that exist. Code drops an item without a reason or with a missing record and never un-forbids a flagged column; the user ticks what to forbid. Without a model, the audit and name rules answer. Measure it on the studied samples.
spec: A reviewer step in the wizard and for the intern; JSON output validated per column ('available' or 'after the moment', a one-sentence reason quoting the moment, record ids from the index). Done when, on the studied samples, the proposals include the R&D's own forbidden columns (for example duration on bank_marketing) and a column proposed without a reason is dropped.
plan: Map the leakage audit pieces, then measure, before designing, what the existing audit and name rules already find on the 16 studied samples: that is the no-model path.

Write studio/leakage_review.py: inputs are the moment, column names with kind, missing rate and unique count (never a value) and the audit's flags; code filters every item; one moment rule reads clauses that exclude something.
Wire it into the wizard's proposal route, the intern (a new review_leakage tool, also on /mcp) and the gateway (its own purpose, covered by the data-limit test).
Show 'The reviewer also asks' on the wizard's solution step, unticked, with the reason and the record; check it in the real page with an uploaded table.
Run check-all and the review; fix four findings and the re-check's one; chase an intermittent PostgreSQL failure and an end-to-end 500 found during the gates; commit the store fix separately.

decisions.decision: Only the audit's own flags are ticked; everything the reviewer adds is shown and never applied.
decisions.why: Code decides, a model advises: a proposal without the audit's evidence is a question for the person, not a change to the solution.

decisions.decision: A column the audit flagged stays flagged whatever a model says; its 'available' is shown as a disagreement.
decisions.why: The package forbids un-forbidding a flagged column; showing the disagreement keeps the model's view visible without letting it weaken the guard.

decisions.decision: Ask a model only when a moment is written.
decisions.why: Without a moment a model's reason cannot quote it, so the check that its reason quotes the moment has nothing to check, and the request costs money for nothing.

change: dclab_rnd/studio/leakage_review.py (review, quotes_moment, the moment rule, measure); the draft proposal route stores the review and reads the wizard's edited moment; the intern's review_leakage tool (21 project tools); the gateway purpose leakage_review; the wizard's 'The reviewer also asks' row; tests/test_leakage_review.py and a data-limit case.

findings.defect: A model's reason skipped the 'quotes the moment' check when there was no moment, and the wizard often sent none.
findings.scenario: review(project, moment=None, ...) with a scripted reply 'age: Anything at all.' kept age as a model item. The wizard's proposal request sent only the target and task, never the moment textarea, and the review never re-ran when the person edited the moment; each such proposal still paid for a standard-tier request.
findings.cause: quotes_moment() returned True for an empty moment, and the wizard did not send its moment.
findings.fix: The model is asked only when a moment is written (quotes_moment is False without one); the wizard sends prediction_moment and the route prefers it.
findings.test: A test that a scripted client is not called when the moment is None, and a wizard-route check that an edited moment is used.

findings.defect: The quote check accepted pairs of function words.
findings.scenario: Moment 'At the monthly snapshot of each customer.' and reason 'Age is recorded at the end of the year.': 'at the' matched, so the item was kept as quoting the moment.
findings.cause: Any two consecutive words of the moment counted as a quote.
findings.fix: The matching words must include a content word of four letters or more.
findings.test: The reason above is dropped; 'Not known at the monthly snapshot.' is kept.

findings.defect: The moment rule took columns from the 'known' part of an excluding clause.
findings.scenario: 'At signup; region and age are known but the outcome is not available' proposed region and age as after the moment, with a reason that read 'The moment says: ...'.
findings.cause: Clauses were split only on full stops and semicolons, and bare 'is not' and 'are not' triggered the rule.
findings.fix: Clauses also split on but, while and whereas, and the bare negations no longer trigger the rule; the studied samples give the same result.
findings.test: A moment-rule test with that sentence.

findings.defect: The purpose's description understated what the model sees.
findings.scenario: may_see said 'the ids and titles of rule records', but the catalogue also sent the titles of leakage_precedent records.
findings.cause: The description was written before the catalogue grew.
findings.fix: The description names rule and leakage-precedent records.

findings.defect: Editing the moment reset the person's ticks (found in the re-check).
findings.scenario: On bank_marketing, tick pdays under 'The reviewer also asks', refine the moment and click elsewhere: the sheet redraws from the server's defaults with pdays unticked, and Accept saves the solution without that column forbidden. Clicking Accept while the moment still has focus can also let a late reply overwrite the accepted sheet with the draft view.
findings.cause: The fix for F1 re-proposed on every moment change and redrew the sheet from the proposal's forbidden list only.
findings.fix: propose() saves the current choices (ticks with reasons, identifiers, time and group columns, metric) and re-applies them to the columns still listed; a reply that arrives after the solution was saved does not redraw.
findings.test: Checked in the real page: a ticked suggestion and an unticked audit flag survive a moment edit.

findings.defect: The end-to-end synthetic flow failed once: opening a project returned 500.
findings.scenario: A GET on a project while its stages were running read a stage file half written; four further runs passed.
findings.cause: Stage records were written in place, and project.json went through a temporary file with one fixed name, so two saves at once could rename each other's file away.
findings.fix: Both are written through a temporary file with its own name in the same folder and an atomic rename (separate commit).
findings.test: A test with two writers and a reader fails on the old store both ways and passes now.

findings.defect: One PostgreSQL test failed once in the gate, very slowly (202 s instead of about 65 s).
findings.scenario: It passed 5 of 5 times alone, under the same load with a state dump, and in make test-pg.
findings.cause: Load from a browser check running at the same time; no race was found in the route.
findings.fix: The gate was rerun with nothing else running; no code change.

measurements.name: the R&D's forbidden columns found on the 16 studied samples, without a model
measurements.gate: The reviewer's proposals include the R&D's own forbidden columns (for example duration on bank_marketing); proposals beyond the R&D's list are counted and shown, never applied.
measurements.result: 14 of 17 found (12 by the audit alone), including duration on bank_marketing; the 3 misses are online_shoppers' 'completed-session counts' (Administrative, Informational, ProductRelated), which name no column. 23 columns proposed beyond the R&D's list: 22 are the audit's own flags, 1 comes from the moment rule (hyperack's first_customer_fare, shown only).
measurements.next: The 3 misses need a reader of what the moment means, not of the column names; the model path is tested with a scripted model only. Recorded as open in the status row.

outcome: Done with the misses recorded: the reviewer runs in the wizard and for the intern, code decides what counts, nothing it adds is applied, and no cell value reaches a model. The gate passed with 473 tests on files and on PostgreSQL, the campaign tests and the four flows; five review findings fixed, and a store race found by the gates fixed separately.
lessons: Measure the no-model path before designing the model path: the audit already found 12 of 17.
A check that passes when its input is empty is not a check; 'quotes the moment' must fail without a moment.
A UI fix that re-fetches defaults can silently undo the person's leakage choices; keep their choices across a redraw.
An intermittent 500 on a read during a run points at a write that is not atomic.
